snippet.title: witan
snippet.description:
A  promo video tryout for witan, an adventure/rpg by gamevial.
Witan is an Anglo Saxon word for a wise or magical person (hopefully, it was when I looked up).

In the game you are more akin to the archetypal "bad witch" than the more than likely innocent victims of persecution in history.
The focus (sometimes lost admittedly) was to avoid the usual shining knights and scantily clad ladies and create a humbler, more believeable-ish medieval (14th to 16th century, when the viking and celtic religions were a "bad memory")  world, although the game is essentially fantasy in every other way.

This game was done over six months with a budget not reaching shoe string, and largely solo. All artwork (as is the case in most games by gamevial) was made in house. We hope to release it steam very soon.

A grateful nod to "kyster" on freesound org who uploaded this for free use:

http://freesound.org/people/Kyster/so...

and 

 https://www.facebook.com/Poebelmusik?...

Poebel, for allowing them to do so. What utterly beautiful music :) I'm going there right now.
